mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a custom-built tiny home and a pre-built model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between custom-built and pre-built depends on your priorities. A custom tiny home offers complete personalization, allowing you to tailor every detail from layout to finishes, ensuring it perfectly fits your lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. This often results in a higher cost and longer build time. Pre-built models are typically more affordable and faster to acquire, but offer limited customization options. If uniqueness and specific functionality are paramount, custom is often the better choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom homes offer full personalization but cost more and take longer. Pre-built homes are faster and cheaper but have limited customization. Choose based on your need for uniqueness versus budget and speed.
